## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the smallest change that achieved it.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] I preserved unrelated user configuration and generated output ownership.
- [ ] I added focused positive and nearby-safe negative tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, prompts, raw commands, vendor session data, or a runtime dependency.
- [ ] I updated the relevant operator documentation and compatibility/threat boundaries.

## Verification

List commands actually run, observed outcomes, and skipped optional validators.

## Review focus

Call out any policy, enforcement, installation, state, product-format, or security boundary change that needs special review.
